common_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one premium photographic lesson-card cover for a Swedish language learning app. Generate ONE separate high-quality photograph, exact landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1024. Consistent restrained Scandinavian editorial photography: soft natural window light, warm off-white, pale oak, linen textures and restrained sage accents; clean calm neutral composition, realistic materials, fine crisp photographic detail, tasteful gentle contrast. The image must read clearly as a small card thumbnail. Keep ALL primary objects entirely inside the frame with at least 10 percent safe margins on every edge. No cut-off people or heads. Avoid staged stock-photo smiles. No illustration, 3D render, collage, split screen, borders, watermarks, UI, logos, captions or overlay typography. Any requested words must be printed naturally on real physical cards or paper, accurately spelled in simple readable dark type; do not add other readable text. Scene:
prompt_recipe: Use prompt_override when present, otherwise concatenate common_prompt and scene.
